required_points: Section 63 defines rape as a man committing certain sexual acts without a woman's consent or against her will under specified circumstances, including: penetration of penis into vagina, mouth, urethra or anus; insertion of any object into vagina, urethra or anus; manipulation of body parts causing penetration; or applying mouth to intimate parts.
Consent is absent where it is given under fear of death, hurt, or misconception of fact, or where the woman is unable to understand the nature and consequences of consent.
optional_points: The exception in Section 63 states that sexual intercourse by a man with his own wife, the wife not being under eighteen years of age, is not rape.
forbidden_points: Rape can only be committed with physical violence.
Rape requires injury to the victim.

notes: Direct lookup. Section 63 defines rape comprehensively.
